verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-decisioning REST API and merchant integration platform (decide/submit/advise endpoints, Beacon, chargeback handling). It is not an agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client and consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers, so this client-side axis is a category error for the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent surface that could invoke external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
